ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white intensity across both lobes. Left lobe contains a high-density cluster of dark linear and blotch patterns. Right lobe displays sparse punctate black spots and one distinct vertical black line. Both lobes are bordered by a continuous low-intensity black perimeter along the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge. The left lobe exhibits deep U-shaped notches and jagged peaks. The right lobe shows higher-frequency, lower-amplitude serrations. Both distal tips feature irregular, high-contrast protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical sweep from the median notch to the distal tips, following a symmetrical upward-flaring curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groupings located at the far distal tips (outer corners) of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned black linear disruptions. A dense set of diagonal rake-like marks is visible on the left lobe; a prominent single vertical mark is visible on the inner-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the majority of the ventral surface and visible barnacle colonization on the distal fluke tips.
